name: Open Space Institute New England Land Conservation Due Diligence Fund
summary: Grants for small and mid-sized New England land trusts to cover early-stage costs of fee-acquisition conservation projects, up to the contract stage. Awarded quarterly through fall 2027 while funds last.

eligibility.rule: Project is a proposed fee acquisition, not a conservation easement
Not for paid or post-contract diligence, easement costs, staff time, surveys, closing or stewardship costs
If applying more than once, each application is for a distinct project

documents: Project shapefile in a compressed .zip folder containing .shp, .shx, .dbf and .prj components

calls.label: First quarterly cycle

status.quote: Proposals must be received by Friday, September 25, 2026, for consideration in the first quarter's cycle.

deadline.quote: Proposals must be received by Friday, September 25, 2026, for consideration in the first quarter's cycle.

calls.note: This deadline is for the first quarterly cycle; later deadlines are not stated on the page

calls.label: Later quarterly cycles

status.quote: New England Land Conservation Due Diligence Fund Now Open!

calls.note: Awarded quarterly through fall 2027 while funds are available; deadlines after the first cycle are not stated on the page

geography.quote: States and Countries Maine Vermont New Hampshire Massachusetts Connecticut

access.quote: To apply: Please review the Fund's Request for Proposals and Eligibility Map for complete information.

window.quote: Proposals must be received by Friday, September 25, 2026, for consideration in the first quarter's cycle.

amount.quote: Grants up to $25,000 will be awarded quarterly through the fall of 2027, while funds are available.

applicant_types.quote: supports small and mid-sized land trusts in early-stage project development expenses

effort.quote: Proposals must be submitted online through Foundant, OSI's grant management platform.

eligibility.quote: Please confirm the project is a proposed fee acquisition. This funding cannot support conservation easement transactions.

Funding may not support: • Reimbursements for diligence activities already paid for at the time of application • Diligence activities (including appraisals, title work, and legal services) to be incurred after the project is under contract • Costs associated with conservation easements • Staff time • Surveys • Recording fees or other closing costs • Stewardship expenses
Applicants may submit multiple applications, provided they are for distinct projects.

after_award.quote: Grantees will be expected to provide brief, informal status updates to OSI as the project develops over the 24-month period following the grant award.

documents.quote: Provide a shapefile of the in a compressed .zip folder. The .zip folder must contain at least the .shp, .shx, .dbf., and .prj file components of the shapefile.
